title: Reinforcing Stereotypes of Anger: Emotion AI on African American Vernacular English

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating emotion recognition models' performance (precision, recall, false positive rates, and false negative rates) on social media text exhibiting African American Vernacular English (AAVE) compared to General American English (GAE) using a computational Dialect Density Metric (DDM).

Correlating neighborhood-level emotion AI predictions (e.g., predictions of anger versus joy) with Census demographic data regarding the racial composition (African American vs. White residents) of those neighborhoods to measure the reinforcement of the 'angry Black person' stereotype.
